name: declan142-calcnook-mcp-server
description: Personal finance calculations across 7 countries (US, UK, CA, AU, AE, SA, India) plus Sharia-compliant Islamic finance (Zakat, Murabaha, Ijarah, Mudarabah, Hajj savings, halal stock screening). 17 tools wrapping the deterministic [calcnook](https://pypi.org/project/calcnook/) engine — income tax, SIP/EMI/loans, retirement, EOSG, VAT, currency formatting (incl. Indian lakh/crore), and BMI/BMR/TDEE. Zero API keys, pure stdlib. Install with `uvx calcnook-mcp`.
